description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository object compatibility with different hash and object formats, including creation and verification of objects like commits, tags, trees, and blobs with different hash algorithms and signed objects.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Returns a compatible hash algorithm based on input (switches 'sha1' to 'sha256' and vice versa).

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'hello' based on the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'tree' based on the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'commit' based on the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for 'commit2' based on the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes GPG signature from the object, depending on the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes signature tags from tags or similar objects based on storage and delete parameters.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Performs various comparisons on object IDs across two repositories, verifying content, type, size, and integrity for both sha1 and sha256 hash formats.
